rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when succumb means to die, including dying from an illness.

example.english: After battling the illness for months, he eventually had to succumb.
example.traditional: 佢同病魔搏鬥咗幾個月，最後都係死喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tung4 beng6 mo1 bok3 dau3 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sei2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for giving in to a temptation or desire rather than simply surrendering to an external force.

example.english: I had promised to give up sweets, but I still succumb to temptation whenever I see cake.
example.traditional: 我明明話咗戒甜品，一見到蛋糕就受唔住誘惑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 ming4 waa6 zo2 gaai3 tim4 ban2 jat1 gin3 dou2 daan6 gou1 zau6 sau6 m4 zyu6 jau5 waak6

rows.note: Use this when someone yields or surrenders to overwhelming force, pressure, or an opponent.

example.english: Under sustained military pressure, the defending forces were eventually forced to succumb.
example.traditional: 面對持續嘅軍事壓力，守軍最後被迫屈服。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 ci4 zuk6 ge3 gwan1 si6 aat3 lik6 sau2 gwan1 zeoi3 hau6 bei6 bik1 wat1 fuk6
